dz: 1383–85年葡萄牙危机:阿尔朱巴罗塔战役:由葡萄牙的约翰一世所指挥的葡萄牙军队击败了卡斯蒂利亚的约翰一世的卡斯蒂利亚军队.
de: Portuguese Crisis of 1383–85: Battle of Aljubarrota: Portuguese forces commanded by John I of Portugal defeat the Castilian army of John I of Castile.

dz: 神圣罗马皇帝查理四世授予卡尔洛维·瓦里城市特权.
de: Charles IV, Holy Roman Emperor, grants city privileges to Karlovy Vary.

t: 盎格鲁-布列顿人在毛伦战役中击败了法军.
te: Anglo-Bretons defeat the French in the Battle of Mauron.
dz: 布列顿继承之战:盎格鲁-布列顿人在毛伦战役中击败了法军.
de: War of the Breton Succession: Anglo-Bretons defeat the French in the Battle of Mauron.

t: 在把威尼斯船队骗入向东航行到莱万特后,热那亚号在萨塞诺战役中捕获了整个威尼斯贸易车队.
te: After tricking the Venetian galley fleet into sailing east to the Levant, the Genoese capture an entire Venetian trade …
dz: 在把威尼斯船队骗入向东航行到莱万特后,热那亚号在萨塞诺战役中捕获了整个威尼斯贸易车队.
de: After tricking the Venetian galley fleet into sailing east to the Levant, the Genoese capture an entire Venetian trade convoy at the Battle of Saseno.

t: 塔伊拉·诺·穆内莫里和塔伊拉一族将年轻的皇帝安多克和三大圣宝收走后逃到日本西部以躲避被米纳本一…
te: Taira no Munemori and the Taira clan take the young Emperor Antoku and the three sacred treasures and flee to western J…
dz: 塔伊拉·诺·穆内莫里和塔伊拉一族将年轻的皇帝安多克和三大圣宝收走后逃到日本西部以躲避被米纳本一族所追杀.
de: Taira no Munemori and the Taira clan take the young Emperor Antoku and the three sacred treasures and flee to western Japan to escape pursuit by the Minamoto clan.

t: Abbasid Caliph al-Rashid Billah逃离了被塞尔柱克土耳其人军队围困…
te: Abbasid Caliph al-Rashid Billah flees from Bagdhad, which had been besieged by an army of the Seljuk Turks under Sultan…
dz: Abbasid Caliph al-Rashid Billah逃离了被塞尔柱克土耳其人军队围困在Sultan Ghiyath ad-Din Mas'ud之下的Bagdhad.
de: Abbasid Caliph al-Rashid Billah flees from Bagdhad, which had been besieged by an army of the Seljuk Turks under Sultan Ghiyath ad-Din Mas'ud for fifty days.

t: 邓肯国王 我死在与他堂兄和对手麦克白的战斗中 后者继承他为苏格兰国王.
te: King Duncan I is killed in battle against his first cousin and rival Macbeth. The latter succeeds him as King of Scotla…
dz: 邓肯国王 我死在与他堂兄和对手麦克白的战斗中 后者继承他为苏格兰国王.
de: King Duncan I is killed in battle against his first cousin and rival Macbeth. The latter succeeds him as King of Scotland.

t: 屋大维在罗马举行了连续三次胜利中的第二次,以庆祝对达尔马提亚部落的胜利.
te: Octavian holds the second of three consecutive triumphs in Rome to celebrate the victory over the Dalmatian tribes.
dz: 屋大维在罗马举行了连续三次胜利中的第二次,以庆祝对达尔马提亚部落的胜利.
de: Octavian holds the second of three consecutive triumphs in Rome to celebrate the victory over the Dalmatian tribes.

te: Gaius Verres is found guilty of corruption after his defense lawyer Quintus Hortensius abandons the case as hopeless.
dz: 盖乌斯·韦雷斯在辩护律师昆图斯·霍滕修斯弃案后被判犯有腐败罪,认为没有希望.
de: Gaius Verres is found guilty of corruption after his defense lawyer Quintus Hortensius abandons the case as hopeless.

dz: 以西汉大臣霍光为首的一批官员，向摄政的上官皇太后呈递弹劾新皇帝刘贺的奏章。
de: A group of officials, led by the Western Han minister Huo Guang, present articles of impeachment against the new emperor, Liu He, to the imperial regent, Empress Dowager Shangguan.
